title: EcoDrop (20% off + free shipping)
description:
The products below are available for 20% off (and free shipping!) as part of our EcoDrop returns initiative.

EcoDrop items are in brand new condition. It’s no different from purchasing an item in-store that was tried on. This is a great way to get your hands on a new product at a discount, or get a product that was previously sold out, all while being more eco-friendly.

EcoDrop items are only in stock for up to 5 days at a time. If you see an item with an EcoDrop option today, it might not be there tomorrow!

*EcoDrop items can only ship to addresses within North America and are final sale.

Read more about EcoDrop.

title: Spring 2022 PRE-SALE
description:
We're doing a quick turnaround pre-sale of some of our most requested bottoms! Pre-orders will ship mid-May 2022.
Can't decide?

Euphoria: Our bestselling Euphoria leggings that have over 700 five star reviews now have pockets! Made with cozy fleece-lined fabric perfect for spring weather and cooler mornings/evenings in the summer (and they make the perfect camping leggings since mosquitoes have a hard time biting through!)

Breeze: Basically a lighter version of the Euphoria, these leggings are also a beloved staple in the Prana Vida capsule (and now have pockets too!). Made with breezy french terry fabric that keep you cool and is ultra breathable, while still being opaque. They are perfect for warmer weather and working out.

Joggers: Our joggers are made in buttery soft jersey fabric, the lightest of all three options. They are also the most maternity friendly of all our bottoms, and are a popular postpartum pick. They are as comfy as PJs and cute to boot - trust me, you'll constantly be reaching for them!

title: Winter 2022 Pre-sale
description:
PRE-ORDERS will ship late November - mid December 2022. 
  • Orders that contain ONLY the non-pocket Fleece-lined Euphoria High Rise Leggings 28" will ship approximately November 23 - 30.
  • All other orders will ship approximately December 8 - 16.
  • Transit times within North America are typically 3 - 5 business days. 
WHY PRE-ORDER? Pre-orders allow us to produce according to demand, therefore eliminating waste.

DID YOU KNOW? The fashion overproduction rate is staggering, ranging from 30 to 40 percent in any given season. It’s estimated that 92 million tons of textile waste is created annually by the fashion industry's overproduction.
